You have now completed the Pre-Appointment Training course.

Throughout this course, you have explored:

  • The responsibilities of Representatives and Key Individuals.
  • Appointment readiness requirements.
  • Fit and Proper requirements.
  • Conflict of Interest management.
  • Disclosure obligations.
  • Permissible financial interests.

As a future Representative or Key Individual, you have a responsibility to act with honesty, integrity, professionalism, and accountability. By understanding and applying the principles covered in this course, you help support fair Customer outcomes, maintain regulatory compliance, and protect the reputation of TFG Insure.

Final Reflection

How will you apply the principles of honesty, fairness, transparency, and accountability in your role to support both Customer outcomes and regulatory compliance?

Remember:

  • Know your responsibilities.
  • Maintain your Fit and Proper status.
  • Disclose interests when required.
  • Follow approved scripts, policies, and processes.
  • Ask questions when in doubt.
  • Always act in the best interests of the Customer.

Thank you for completing the course and taking an important step towards becoming appointment ready at TFG Insure.
